name: Dial by Behaf
description: Hosted MCP server that lets an AI assistant phone Indian businesses for bookings, enquiries, customer care and follow-ups. It gets through menus and hold, talks in English or Indian languages, and returns a summary, outcome and transcript. Every call says it is an AI calling on the user's behalf. Tools: prepare_call, place_call, get_call, get_call_transcript, answer_call_question, list_calls, cancel_call, get_account.
